entries.text: Fixed QuestDB queries using HAVING failing with "unexpected token [HAVING]" (TPC-H Q11, TPC-DS Q6/Q24, ClickBench Q28/Q29, AMPLab, TSBS DevOps, DataVault, TPC-DI and others); the adapter now rewrites GROUP BY ... HAVING into a filtered derived table that preserves ORDER BY, LIMIT, DISTINCT, window functions and scalar-subquery conditions.
